summary: Converts speaker-based, custom, or ambisonic audio input into two-channel binaural output using Steam Audio HRTF rendering.
key_concepts: Audio Binaural CHOP uses Steam Audio HRTF rendering to convert multichannel speaker layouts into two-channel binaural output.
Input Format determines the required input channel count for stereo, quadraphonic, 5.1, 7.1, custom, or ambisonic sources.
Ambisonics input uses Ambisonics Order, with higher orders requiring more input channels.
Custom speaker setups use a mapping DAT with x, y, and z columns describing speaker positions.
A listener COMP can provide orientation for ambisonics before binaural rendering.

key_params.name: ambisonicsorder
key_params.note: Ambisonics order when using ambisonic input

common_gotchas: Input audio must use a Steam Audio compatible sample rate, commonly 44100 or 48000 Hz.
Custom setups need a correct mapping table; channel order mistakes are spatially obvious but hard to debug visually.
Binaural output is two-channel and intended for headphones or VR-style monitoring.
Listener orientation matters; bind it to the same camera/head transform used by the visual scene when appropriate.
